evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Combines broad discovery and content identification/fingerprinting capabilities, making scope too large for a reasonable estimate.

evaluations.evidence: based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Profile-based music discovery is broad and underspecified without clearer scope or behavior.

evaluations.evidence: other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Similarity between users and the resulting discovery behavior are too vague to estimate reasonably.

evaluations.evidence: similar to a given music video based on content similarity
evaluations.rationale: Content similarity across music videos and ringback tones is very broad and underspecified.

evaluations.evidence: enriched metadata and image tags, so that I find related artists, new genre, or other relevant listening path
evaluations.rationale: Multiple possible discovery paths and vague outputs make scope too broad for a reliable estimate.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Uploading and making tags available is bounded enough to estimate, though integration is broad.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Thumbnail sequence viewing is a concrete UI feature with clear scope.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Similarity and the type of information are too vague to form a reasonable implementation estimate.

evaluations.evidence: perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Perceptual similarity is technically broad and underspecified, making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Similar profiles and recommendation behavior are not specified enough for reliable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Relevance and area are vague, leaving scope too broad to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Person identification plus related information retrieval is broad and underspecified.

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Product identification scope is very large and the related information is unspecified.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Broadcaster logos are a bounded class and the information lookup can be estimated reasonably.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos
evaluations.rationale: Brands are an unbounded and broad set, making scope difficult to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: recommended with videos related to that picture or image
evaluations.rationale: Video recommendation based on image similarity is broad and underspecified.

evaluations.evidence: walk around, access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area, monuments or any other relevant point of interest
evaluations.rationale: Combines mapping, POI detection, and content retrieval with broad scope, making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: ASR-based search is a bounded, well-understood capability.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: This is a concrete admin tool for video segmentation review and editing.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Segment annotation and topic extraction are defined enough for a reasonable implementation estimate.

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: A/V quality aspects are vague and numerous, making scope too broad to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Audio editing detection is a specific enough objective.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Nudity prefiltering is a clear, bounded classification task.

evaluations.evidence: search based on low-level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Low-level asset information is vague, leaving the search scope underdefined.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Copyright infringement validation is a very broad legal-technical capability.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high-level asset information such as metadata and tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata/tag-based content prefiltering is reasonably bounded and estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: assess how interesting or appealing or complex a picture is
evaluations.rationale: Interestingness, appeal, and complexity are subjective broad concepts, making scope hard to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: detect when a scientist should be prompted to look at a subject
evaluations.rationale: Trigger conditions for prompting are vague and underspecified.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Volunteer types are undefined, making the requirement too broad to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low-level image features
evaluations.rationale: Specific dataset and feature-level classification approach provide enough scope for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Clear binary detection task in a specific dataset.

evaluations.evidence: automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction in Snapshot Serengeti images
evaluations.rationale: Specific problem of detecting image series under timestamp malfunction is bounded.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal species preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is a concrete classification task in a known dataset.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal attribute preclassification in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Though attributes are not enumerated, the domain context makes the classification scope estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: automatic animal number detection in Snapshot Serengeti
evaluations.rationale: Count detection is a specific task with clear scope.

evaluations.evidence: automatic segmentation or localization of plankton in Plankton Portal
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation/localization of plankton is a bounded vision task.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Clear binary detection task in a specific dataset.

evaluations.evidence: automatic detection of plankton size or orientation in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Specific measurable properties make scope estimatable.

evaluations.evidence: automatic preclassification of plankton species in Plankton Portal images
evaluations.rationale: Species preclassification is concrete and bounded.

evaluations.evidence: automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration in Worm Watch Lab
evaluations.rationale: Motion analysis and the means of video duration reduction are underspecified, making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Specific event detection in a defined video context.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc in the satellite images
evaluations.rationale: The listed feature classes are concrete enough to bound the detection scope.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer's classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Probability weighting by experience is a bounded analytical feature.

evaluations.evidence: prefiltering of the images to remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Artifact removal examples make this a concrete filtering task.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving/transient object detection is specific enough for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Audio denoising is a concrete signal-processing task.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Though similarity is not fully specified, whale call grouping is sufficiently bounded acoustically for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Counting whales in an audio file is a concrete detection task.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Interruption timing is vague and behavior is not specified enough to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Trigger and modality decision logic are underspecified, making scope broad.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Education timing is broad and not sufficiently defined for estimation.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Decision criteria are vague, making implementation scope unclear.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Selecting education content is broad and underspecified.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Interesting comment detection is subjective and undefined.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Comment trigger conditions are vague and broad.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Explanation timing is underspecified and difficult to estimate.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Open-ended dialogue behavior is too broad for reliable estimation.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Subject similarity is vague and the grouping scope is broad.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Project recommendation scope and experience features are broad, making estimation difficult.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Summarization and reuse are broad and underspecified capabilities.
